body:
Overall correctness: No

There are functional regressions (missing effects), bugs in audio timing (mixer lag), and configuration inconsistencies.

comments.body: [P1] The Reverb and Delay effects from the original implementation (and mentioned in the new README) are missing. Only `gainNodes` for volume are implemented.

[P2] Volume and Mute changes only update the React state and are not applied to the audio engine until the next note is scheduled. This causes a delay in mixer response and fails to silence active notes immediately. Consider calling `audioEngine.setTrackVolume` here or in a side effect.
[P2] The configuration sets `steps` to 12, but the README and original functionality specify a 16-step sequencer.
[P3] The project guidelines in `GEMINI.md` specify using standard Tailwind utility classes. This PR introduces a large custom CSS file instead.
